sloka: तन्त्रीस्वनाह् कर्णसुखाः प्रवृत्ताः ।स्वपन्ति नार्यः पतिभिः सुवृत्ताः ।नक्तम्चराश्चापि तथा प्रवृत्ता ।विहर्तुमत्यद्भुतरौद्रवृत्ताः ॥५-५-९॥
transliteration: tantrīsvanāh karṇasukhāḥ pravṛttāḥ ।svapanti nāryaḥ patibhiḥ suvṛttāḥ ।naktamcarāścāpi tathā pravṛttā ।vihartumatyadbhutaraudravṛttāḥ ॥5-5-9॥

translations.english: Pleasing sounds of string instruments had begun to be heard. Chaste women were found asleep with their husbands.The nightrangers had begun their strange (evil and cruel) deeds exhibiting their anger.
